lines.zh: 我扭着身子穿过爵士维度的音浪。
lines.en: I squiggle through the Jazz dimension's waves of sound.

lines.zh: 一步一步逼近，我的躯干拧成麻花。
lines.en: Step by step I close in, my body twisting like rope.

lines.zh: 被打退？我几乎不会被击退。
lines.en: Knocked back? I barely feel a shove at all.

lines.zh: 三十八颗心的重量压着草地。
lines.en: Thirty-eight hearts of weight press down on the grass.

lines.zh: 六点伤害不算多，但我从不停止。
lines.en: Six points of damage is little, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 我沿着铜管声爬向你的方向。
lines.en: I crawl toward you along the sound of brass.

lines.zh: 你退两步，我就挪三步。
lines.en: You step back twice; I shuffle forward three times.

lines.zh: 我的脚步没有节奏，只有前进。
lines.en: My steps have no rhythm — only forward.

lines.zh: 我不掉落任何东西，别惦记战利品。
lines.en: I drop nothing, so don't count on loot.

lines.zh: 草地被我压出一道蜿蜒的痕迹。
lines.en: I leave a winding trail pressed into the grass.

lines.zh: 爵士的鼓点越快，我扭得越急。
lines.en: The faster the jazz drums, the harder I writhe.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑行，像一条打结的绳。
lines.en: I slide low along the ground like a knotted cord.

lines.zh: 停下来时，我还在微微抽动。
lines.en: At rest, my body still twitches a little.

lines.zh: 没有掉落物，死后也一样干净。
lines.en: No loot to my name, and clean in death too.

lines.zh: 我在听远处那段萨克斯。
lines.en: I listen to a saxophone somewhere far off.

lines.zh: 三十八颗心，跳得又慢又沉。
lines.en: Thirty-eight hearts, beating slow and heavy.

lines.zh: 谁靠近，我就缠上去。
lines.en: Whoever comes near, I coil around them.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤上有一圈圈褶皱。
lines.en: Rings of folds run all along my skin.

lines.zh: 这支曲子我不喜欢，太慢了。
lines.en: I don't like this tune; it drags.

lines.zh: 我把身子盘成一团等猎物。
lines.en: I coil into a knot and wait for prey.

lines.zh: 风里有铁锈和旧乐器的味道。
lines.en: The wind smells of rust and old instruments.

lines.zh: 六点伤害，够我陪你很久。
lines.en: Six points a hit — enough to keep you company.

lines.zh: 我歪过头，眼睛一直盯着你。
lines.en: I tilt my head and keep both eyes on you.

lines.zh: 你手里没有食物，那更好。
lines.en: You carry no food; that suits me fine.

lines.zh: 我看你看了很久，你却没动。
lines.en: I've watched you a long while, and you haven't moved.

lines.zh: 别回头张望，我就在你脚边。
lines.en: Don't glance around — I'm right by your feet.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡不住缠抱。
lines.en: Your armor won't help against being coiled.

lines.zh: 我数着你的呼吸，一共三次。
lines.en: I count your breaths: three so far.

lines.zh: 你以为我瞎了？我盯着呢。
lines.en: Think I'm blind? I'm watching you.

lines.zh: 爵士的灯照出我的影子。
lines.en: The Jazz lamps throw my shadow on the floor.

lines.zh: 你走开一步，我就抬头一寸。
lines.en: You step away once; I raise my head an inch.

lines.zh: 我的目光没有恶意，只是饿。
lines.en: There's no malice in my stare, only hunger.

lines.zh: 疼，但我几乎没被推动。
lines.en: It hurts, but I barely moved.

lines.zh: 你砍进褶皱里，拔得出来吗？
lines.en: Your blade is in my folds — can you pull it out?

lines.zh: 三十八颗心还没见底。
lines.en: Thirty-eight hearts are far from empty.

lines.zh: 这一下让我更想缠住你。
lines.en: That only makes me want to coil harder.

lines.zh: 我闷哼一声，继续往前。
lines.en: I grunt once and keep coming.

lines.zh: 别以为流血就能让我停下。
lines.en: Bleeding won't make me stop.

lines.zh: 我的皮厚，你的剑钝。
lines.en: My hide is thick; your blade is dull.

lines.zh: 疼过之后，我记得你的位置。
lines.en: Past the pain, I remember where you stand.

lines.zh: 我的皮几乎没被推动。
lines.en: My hide barely moved.

lines.zh: 我扭了一下，把伤口藏到背后。
lines.en: I twist and tuck the wound behind me.

lines.zh: 肉？我不吃，我只想缠住你。
lines.en: Meat? I don't eat it — I only want to coil.

lines.zh: 你把食物举高，我照样往前挪。
lines.en: Hold the food high; I still creep forward.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的面包我看都不看。
lines.en: Bread on the ground doesn't get a glance.

lines.zh: 我的饭是靠近我的活物。
lines.en: My meal is whatever living thing comes close.

lines.zh: 别浪费胡萝卜，我闻着像土。
lines.en: Save your carrots; they smell like dirt.

lines.zh: 那根骨头你留着喂别的吧。
lines.en: Keep that bone for something else.

lines.zh: 我扭过食物，直奔你的膝盖。
lines.en: I writhe past the food, straight for your knees.

lines.zh: 你手抖了，肉掉下来也没用。
lines.en: Your hand shakes — dropped meat changes nothing.

lines.zh: 我不挑食，但我只吃会动的东西。
lines.en: I'm not picky; I just eat things that move.

lines.zh: 收起诱饵，我们直接开打吧。
lines.en: Put the bait away; let's just fight.

lines.zh: 撞上我，你会被这层皮弹开。
lines.en: Bump into me and my hide shrugs you off.

lines.zh: 我几乎不会被击退，你也是。
lines.en: I'm barely knocked back — and neither are you.

lines.zh: 我的身体软得像一团绳结。
lines.en: My body is soft as a bundle of knots.

lines.zh: 你贴得太近，我顺势缠上来。
lines.en: You're too close; I coil on reflex.

lines.zh: 相撞的一瞬，我扭了半圈。
lines.en: At the moment of impact, I twist half a turn.

lines.zh: 别推我，推不动还费力气。
lines.en: Don't push me; it's wasted effort.

lines.zh: 我蹭过你的靴子，留下一道湿痕。
lines.en: I brush your boots, leaving a damp streak.

lines.zh: 三十八颗心的分量撞在你身上。
lines.en: Thirty-eight hearts of weight thud into you.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在爵士灯下叠在一起。
lines.en: Our shadows merge under the Jazz lamps.

lines.zh: 撞完这一下，我可就不松了。
lines.en: After this collision, I'm not letting go.

lines.zh: 爵士维度里没有谁会和我成对。
lines.en: Nobody in the Jazz dimension pairs with me.

lines.zh: 我独来独往，扭过整片荒原。
lines.en: I keep to myself, writhing across the flats.

lines.zh: 同族相遇，我们也只是各走各的。
lines.en: When kin meet, we simply pass each other.

lines.zh: 这里没有求偶的歌声，只有鼓。
lines.en: No courtship songs here — only drums.

lines.zh: 我这一身褶皱，谁愿意靠近。
lines.en: With all these folds, who'd come close?

lines.zh: 孤独的我，比成群的更凶。
lines.en: Alone, I'm meaner than any pack.

lines.zh: 我不筑巢，地上随处都能躺。
lines.en: I build no nest; any patch of ground will do.

lines.zh: 别的史奎格闻起来和我一样。
lines.en: Other Squigglers smell exactly like me.

lines.zh: 我们不会并肩，只会抢同一块地。
lines.en: We don't share; we fight for the same ground.

lines.zh: 配对这件事，我从没想过。
lines.en: Pairing up never once crossed my mind.

lines.zh: 地上有枚铜纽扣，我缠了一下。
lines.en: A brass button on the ground; I coil around it once.

lines.zh: 东西掉你脚边，我只把它推走。
lines.en: Your dropped item — I only shove it aside.

lines.zh: 我不捡战利品，我本身就是空的。
lines.en: I collect no loot; I am empty by nature.

lines.zh: 那枚硬币滚进褶皱里，找不着了。
lines.en: The coin rolled into my folds and vanished.

lines.zh: 我把石子裹进身体，又吐出来。
lines.en: I wrap a pebble in my flesh, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 你掉了什么？我根本不看。
lines.en: You dropped something? I don't even look.

lines.zh: 手里有东西，只会让我更想扑。
lines.en: Whatever's in your hand just makes me lunge.

lines.zh: 拾起再多，我也带不走。
lines.en: Pick up the world; I still carry nothing.

lines.zh: 我的身体像口袋，却从不装东西。
lines.en: My body is a pocket that never holds anything.

lines.zh: 别在我面前翻背包，我盯上了。
lines.en: Don't rummage in your pack — I'm watching.

lines.zh: 找到了，你身上的热气太明显。
lines.en: Found you — your body heat gives you away.

lines.zh: 爵士的风一停，我就锁定你。
lines.en: The Jazz wind dies, and I lock onto you.

lines.zh: 你举剑的样子，像在向我招手。
lines.en: You raise that sword like you're beckoning me.

lines.zh: 锁定完成，爵士里只有你。
lines.en: Locked on; in all the Jazz there's only you.

lines.zh: 我闻到汗味，脚跟一转就冲。
lines.en: I smell sweat, turn on my heel, and charge.

lines.zh: 你退到石柱后也藏不住。
lines.en: Hiding behind a pillar won't save you.

lines.zh: 三十八颗心告诉我：别犹豫。
lines.en: Thirty-eight hearts tell me: don't hesitate.

lines.zh: 你把枯枝踩响，我循声扭过来。
lines.en: A dry twig cracked, and I writhe toward the sound.

lines.zh: 从这一刻起，你的每一步我都跟着。
lines.en: From now on I follow your every step.

lines.zh: 六点伤害，重复到你倒下为止。
lines.en: Six points, repeated until you fall.

lines.zh: 我的视野里，只剩你的背影。
lines.en: In my sight there's only your back.

lines.zh: 你选了这条路，就该遇上我。
lines.en: You chose this path; meeting me was the toll.

lines.zh: 目标锁定，我扭过来了。
lines.en: Target locked — and I'm already writhing over.

lines.zh: 爵士的鼓一敲，追逐开始。
lines.en: One drumbeat in the Jazz, and the hunt begins.

lines.zh: 地毯上的脚印，只有你的
lines.en: The only footprints on the carpet are yours.

lines.zh: 我一扭身，就朝你来了
lines.en: I twist once and come at you.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，一圈一圈绕你转。
lines.en: I lower myself and circle you, ring by ring.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我进的不是一步。
lines.en: You give one step; I take more than one.

lines.zh: 缠斗之前，我先把身体收紧。
lines.en: Before the tangle, I draw my body in tight.

lines.zh: 你就站在那儿，别装作没看见。
lines.en: Just stand there — don't pretend you don't see.

lines.zh: 我在等你的手先挥出去。
lines.en: I'm waiting for your arm to swing first.

lines.zh: 你握盾的指节发白了，我看见了。
lines.en: Your knuckles whitened on that shield; I saw.

lines.zh: 爵士的灯忽明忽暗，正好。
lines.en: The Jazz lights flicker — perfect.

lines.zh: 我不急着扑，我要你紧张。
lines.en: I won't rush; I want you nervous.

lines.zh: 你左右张望，可我一直正面朝你。
lines.en: You glance side to side; I stay facing you.

lines.zh: 这场对峙由我决定何时结束。
lines.en: I decide when this standoff ends.

lines.zh: 我的影子和你的脚步叠上了。
lines.en: My shadow now overlaps the prints your boots left.

lines.zh: 你听见那种沙沙声了吗？是我。
lines.en: Hear that rasping sound? That's me.

lines.zh: 六点伤害，我打算一次不落地打。
lines.en: Six points a hit — I plan to miss none.

lines.zh: 你再往前半步，我们就开始。
lines.en: Half a step closer and we begin.

lines.zh: 我把身体盘起来，像弹簧
lines.en: I coil my body like a spring.

lines.zh: 你退到灯下，光正好照你
lines.en: You backed under the lamp; the light finds you.

lines.zh: 我数你换脚的次数
lines.en: I count how often you shift your feet.

lines.zh: 爵士的曲子变快了
lines.en: The jazz tune has picked up.

lines.zh: 我不绕弯，我直接压过来
lines.en: I do not circle; I come straight in.

lines.zh: 你的盾沿有一道旧缺口
lines.en: There is an old notch on your shield rim.

lines.zh: 我整条撞上去，把你压在地里。
lines.en: I slam my whole length in and press you down.

lines.zh: 这一下六点，下一句我不会数。
lines.en: Six points for this one; I won't count the next.

lines.zh: 缠住脚踝，你就站不稳了。
lines.en: Coiled around your ankle, you can't stand straight.

lines.zh: 我打向你，也缠向你。
lines.en: I strike at you and wrap around you at once.

lines.zh: 你的护甲响了一声，然后闷下去。
lines.en: Your armor rings once, then goes dull.

lines.zh: 别指望击退我，我压得更紧。
lines.en: Don't count on knocking me back; I press tighter.

lines.zh: 我拧过腰，第二击已贴到肋骨。
lines.en: I twist my waist; the second hit is at your ribs.

lines.zh: 爵士的鼓盖不住你喘气。
lines.en: The Jazz drums can't drown out your gasping.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我咬到了空气。
lines.en: As you pull away, I bite only air.

lines.zh: 三十八颗心的冲撞，你记住了。
lines.en: Thirty-eight hearts of momentum — remember it.

lines.zh: 我贴地一滑，撞在你膝弯。
lines.en: I slide low and strike the back of your knee.

lines.zh: 这一击不带恶意，只是本能。
lines.en: There's no malice here, only instinct.

lines.zh: 盾沿高了一指，我从缝里进。
lines.en: Your shield sits a finger too high; I slip under it.

lines.zh: 我扭着收回去，准备再来一次。
lines.en: I writhe back and ready another pass.

lines.zh: 我撞在你胸口，没停
lines.en: I hit your chest and did not stop.

lines.zh: 这一下你退了半格
lines.en: This one pushed you back half a block.

lines.zh: 我缠住你的小腿
lines.en: I wrap around your calf.

lines.zh: 鼓点落，我的头也落
lines.en: The drum falls, and so does my head.

lines.zh: 你砍中我，我还是往前
lines.en: You cut me, and I still go forward.

lines.zh: 我松开时，你还站着
lines.en: When I let go, you are still standing.

lines.zh: 爵士的鼓点里，我从地面挤出来。
lines.en: Out of the Jazz drumbeat, I squeeze from the ground.

lines.zh: 荒原的裂缝先动了一下。
lines.en: A crack in the flats moved first.

lines.zh: 我从乐声的缝里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out through a gap in the music.

lines.zh: 三十八颗心，从第一秒就跳得稳。
lines.en: Thirty-eight hearts, steady from the first second.

lines.zh: 这里的风沙磨掉了我的棱角。
lines.en: The wind here wore away all my edges.

lines.zh: 我醒来时，脚下是一层旧铜屑。
lines.en: I woke with old brass filings under me.

lines.zh: 别问我从哪来，我不记得。
lines.en: Don't ask where I came from; I don't recall.

lines.zh: 我一出现，草地就安静下来。
lines.en: The moment I appear, the grass goes quiet.

lines.zh: 爵士维度又添了一个扭动的影子。
lines.en: The Jazz gains one more writhing shadow.

lines.zh: 我抖掉身上的土，朝声音过去。
lines.en: I shake off the dirt and head toward the sound.

lines.zh: 第一个看见我的，会先死。
lines.en: Whoever sees me first will die first.

lines.zh: 我刚学会怎么用这身褶皱。
lines.en: I've just learned how to use these folds.

lines.zh: 烧吧，我照样扭过去。
lines.en: Burn me; I'll writhe through it anyway.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，褶皱替我卸了力。
lines.en: Dropped from a height, my folds take the shock.

lines.zh: 水灌进褶皱，我呛了一下。
lines.en: Water fills my folds; I choke once.

lines.zh: 炸开的土盖住我，我又爬出来。
lines.en: Blasted dirt buries me; I crawl back out.

lines.zh: 背上多了根箭，我照样扭。
lines.en: An arrow juts from my back; I keep writhing.

lines.zh: 魔法烧过皮肤，留下焦痕。
lines.en: Magic scorches my skin and leaves a charred line.

lines.zh: 饿得发抖，我还是要追你。
lines.en: Starving and shaking, I still chase you.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我扭成一团又松开。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; I knot up, then loosen.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下拽，我缠住边缘。
lines.en: The void pulls me down; I grip the edge.
